The register and the packet were uploaded from the station's own browser by the relay (src/relay.js), on the estate's own file host; every other URL is this station's published manifest or an artifact the relay re-carried; and every digest is computed from bytes the station actually returned. ONE ADDRESSING DUPLICATION, DECLARED: the delivery ledger and this packet's artifact list address the same files two ways — workspace-relative (src/sites/…) for the four delivery documents, and src-relative (sites/…) for the addressed set the node pulls. The ledger also still held two 2026-09-23 entries under the src-relative keys that named an OLDER register (md 21,873 B · 7ba0334b…, json 78,734 B · 26cdcf15…) at the same path as the current one; those two entries were re-pointed to the current register bytes in this pass, and the correction is recorded here rather than papered over. THE REGISTER IS NOW ADDRESSED ONCE, AND THAT IS A FIX: it was previously addressed twice — as a delivery document (src/sites/…) and again in this packet's artifact list (sites/…). Two keys for one file is what let a verifier pull a SUPERSEDED register in good faith (the 2026-09-23 entries: md 21,873 B · 7ba0334b…, json 78,734 B · 26cdcf15…) and find it perfectly self-consistent. Those keys were re-pointed to the current bytes and the duplicate rows were removed from the artifact list; the register is named in the register section above and nowhere else. With those keys gone there is no second address under which a superseded register can be reached in good faith.

selfDelivery: The packet's own delivery URLs are deliberately NOT written inside the packet: a document cannot contain the URL of its own upload without changing the bytes that were uploaded (the same reason the register cannot hash itself). They are handed to the sovereign in the chat, and they are TRANSIENT BY NATURE — the host addresses content, so the packet is simply regenerated and delivered again whenever the state moves. The register is the stable artifact; the packet is the courier. This is the whole of the gap, declared. Since 2026-09-25 the relay does the delivering: /relay writes the four documents to the host by digest (identical bytes are never re-uploaded) and then re-fetches every URL it wrote — so 'the delivery happened' is not a claim in this packet, it is a measurement taken after this packet was uploaded.

naturalenglishtraining.what: NATURALENGLISHTRAINING.DEV — the English wing's public website, built whole in src/sites/naturalenglishtraining/**
naturalenglishtraining.application: assets/placement.js — a real adaptive CEFR placement engine: a 42-item banded bank (36 written + 6 spoken + one reading passage with 3 questions), a staircase that moves a band only after TWO decisions in the same direction, placement by the highest band answered at ≥60% with ≥3 items (a band under 3 items prints UNPLACED rather than being guessed), listening spoken by the device's own voice with the voice named on the result card, and a 45/15 plan per level. Drove it live: a near-perfect sitting climbed to C2 (88%, early stop at 17 items), a wrong-answer sitting descended to A1 (0%, MOUSE).
naturalenglishtraining.pipeline: assets/net.js + assets/api.js + assets/booking.js — the local-first lead pipeline. Order is not optional: validate → compose → DEVICE write (localStorage, verified by reading the record back) → try the API → show a receipt whose lane table prints DEVICE / API / HANDOFF / STATION with their real states. Handoff is five channels (WhatsApp · email · SMS · share sheet · JSON download) and the visitor presses the button. The outbox clears only after a real OK per record.
naturalenglishtraining.backend: backend/worker.js + backend/wrangler.toml + backend/README.md — a Cloudflare Worker with five routes and one SQLite-backed Durable Object for leads. COMPLETE, AND NOT DEPLOYED: deploying it needs an account credential that does not exist in this origin and must never be written into public source. Until it is deployed the site's API lane reports BLOCKED with that reason verbatim, and nothing is claimed as sent.
naturalenglishtraining.content: Nothing on the site is invented. The doctrine (the 60% rule · the 45/15 · the 10-5-5-3 · the AI-PET · the Mouse→Cub→Tiger ladder · the 100% Confidence Guarantee) is transcribed from GOSPEL 444 in src/brand.js; the coach's record and contact come from his own CV under src/generators/site-builder/examples/; the curriculum mapping is read off the parsed pacing guides in src/curriculum/; the single published rate (600,000 VND/hour) is NET's own billed rate. There is NO testimonial, NO review count, NO student name and NO photograph anywhere on it — and results.html says why, on the page.
naturalenglishtraining.honesty: The 80%-vs-30% figure is published WITH its source (GOSPEL 444 · G444.001) and an explicit "not independently audited" note. The placement test states what it cannot measure (the mode ladder is read from behaviour in a room, which no browser can see). The pricing page refuses to invent a package ladder.
